reasoning: The icon consists only of a circle containing the stacked digits '12' and '36' (intended as a Material-style stacked digital watch face showing 12:36). Because it is purely digits inside a plain ring with no watch straps or clock hands, it violates the rule against icons that are only letters or digits and is not readable at a glance compared to a standard clock or watch icon.
